Title: Recon of Pan-IIM app, PlanOS site and Cinemetrica reference
Acceptance criteria: Findings logged in PRD section 2 with source links.

Title: Draft PRD v0.1
Acceptance criteria: PRD v0.1 published and shared with organizers.

Title: Confirm stack, repo access, staging and deploy path with the PlanOS team
Acceptance criteria: Written confirmation of framework, backend, auth provider, storage and deploy flow; staging URL; permission to add tables and server functions.

Title: Decide chip tier (A: NTAG21x static, B: NTAG 424 DNA) from vendor quotes and lead times
Acceptance criteria: Two written quotes with unit price, lead time and pre-encoding capability; tier chosen and logged as D-1.

Title: Organizer sign-off on headcount, privacy defaults, retention and fiduciary wording
Acceptance criteria: Headcount N, consent defaults, 30-day retention and the data-fiduciary name confirmed in writing.

Title: Seed theme taxonomy (domains) from the paper tracks and wireframe themes
Acceptance criteria: themes table holds 8 to 12 rows with slug, label, colour; every paper track and every wireframe theme chip maps to one theme.

Title: Card artwork: logo, QR, printed 6-char code, tap-here mark; vendor spec sheet
Acceptance criteria: Print-ready file approved by organizers; vendor confirms spec in writing.

Title: Token generator, card manifest CSV and pre-bound pass list (80-bit tokens, printed codes, name on card)
Acceptance criteria: Script outputs N plus 10% spares, zero duplicate tokens, CSV matches vendor encoding template; if D-2 is pre-bound, every delegate row carries a token.

Title: Place card order with 10% spares (quantity = ceil(1.1 x N))
Acceptance criteria: Order confirmation with ship date no later than 18 Nov.

Title: Vendor production and transit to Shillong (external wait, 10 days assumed)
Acceptance criteria: Cards physically on campus by 25 Nov.

Title: Dev test tags: write 20 blank NTAG tags with test URLs for engineers
Acceptance criteria: 20 tags in engineers' hands; each opens /t/<test-token> on iPhone XS+ and Android.

Title: Vendor pre-production sample: 5 encoded cards air-shipped
Acceptance criteria: 5 samples read correctly by 6 phone models; photo proof of print quality.

Title: Goods-in check: count, read-test 10% sample, quarantine failures
Acceptance criteria: Failure rate under 2% on sample; failed cards logged and replaced from spares.

Title: Desk kit: signage, volunteer script, spare cards, NFC-capable test phones
Acceptance criteria: Kit checklist signed off by desk lead; spares added from the goods-in batch.

Title: Migration and RLS: nfc_cards, connections (with source and context), blocks, tap_events, consents
Acceptance criteria: All five tables have RLS on; anon key returns zero rows from each; migration reversible; connections.source holds tap, scan, coffee, circle, office_hours, table.

Title: Route /t/:token: states (unbound, active, revoked, unknown) and sign-in with return path
Acceptance criteria: Each state renders a distinct screen; sign-in returns to the same token URL.

Title: RPCs get_profile_by_token and connect_via_card (idempotent, undo, rate limited)
Acceptance criteria: Second call with same pair returns existing row; GET path writes nothing; 30 resolves per minute per user cap enforced.

Title: iOS spike: Safari tab vs installed PWA sign-in state, and one-tap return path
Acceptance criteria: Written finding with screenshots; sign-in from a tap takes at most 2 taps on iPhone.

Title: Connection rules: unique pair, self-tap block, source and session tagging, record_meeting() for non-tap sources
Acceptance criteria: Duplicate pair impossible at DB level; met_at_session filled from calendar when a session is live; record_meeting accepts only the six listed sources.

Title: Tap result screen: compact profile card, connect with 8 s undo, already-connected state, contact on accept
Acceptance criteria: Median tap to rendered profile 2.0 s or less on 4G with a warm session; contact fields stay hidden until the card owner's accept rule is met.

Title: Card activation: self-activate after sign-in; desk bind and unbind
Acceptance criteria: Unbound card tap leads to activation; printed 6-char code required; consent captured before binding; audit row written.

Title: QR on digital pass and share-link fallback (same /t/:token URL)
Acceptance criteria: QR scanned by native camera on iOS and Android opens the profile flow.

Title: People I've met: list in Me with search, private note, remove connection
Acceptance criteria: Remove deletes the edge for both sides; note visible only to its author.

Title: Lost or stolen card: revoke and reissue
Acceptance criteria: Old token shows 'deactivated'; new card binds in under 60 s at desk.

Title: Profile schema: headline, bio, photo, role, institute, themes (max 3), interest tags, ask and offer, visibility scope
Acceptance criteria: Existing registrants keep their data; new columns nullable; themes join table, ask/offer text and visibility_scope (presenters, all, met) in place.

Title: Profile editor in onboarding step 2: domain picker, interests, photo upload, contact fields
Acceptance criteria: Photo resized to 512 px client side; at most 3 domains; completion bar updates live.

Title: Visibility banner and settings: scope selector, share-on-tap, discoverable, versioned log, one-tap withdraw
Acceptance criteria: Every grant and withdrawal writes a row with version and timestamp; scope change takes effect on the next request; banner copy matches the wireframe.

Title: Profile detail RPC applying scope, accept and block rules
Acceptance criteria: Contact fields never returned to non-accepted people; blocked pairs return nothing; unit tests for every combination of scope (3), optional toggles (3) and viewer relationship (stranger, met, accepted, blocked): 96 cases.

Title: Profile screen per wireframe plus constellation extras (mutual, path to me, shared sessions, note, report)
Acceptance criteria: Matches the wireframed profile layout; adds mutual connections, path to me, shared sessions and note; used by tap, directory and constellation.

Title: Profile-completion nudge on Home and email to registered delegates
Acceptance criteria: Banner live; email sent to 100% of registered delegates by 22 Nov.

Title: Graph spike: d3-force on canvas with 150 synthetic nodes, measure fps
Acceptance criteria: At least 30 fps on a mid-range Android phone; written finding.

Title: Network page: add map entry points to wireframed home, lazy-loaded graph chunk
Acceptance criteria: Chunk loads only when the map opens; chunk is 100 kB gzipped or less; wireframed sections stay in their order.

Title: RPC get_ego_graph (depth 2, cap 300 nodes, scope and block rules honoured)
Acceptance criteria: Response p95 under 400 ms for a 150-node neighbourhood; hidden, blocked and out-of-scope users never appear.

Title: Constellation v1: canvas render, zoom, pan, drag, domain colours, size by degree, edge width by similarity
Acceptance criteria: Layout settles in 3 s or less; labels only for top-degree and hovered nodes.

Title: Node tap opens profile panel; neighbour highlight; path-to-me; keyboard navigation
Acceptance criteria: Tap target at least 44 px; Esc closes panel; focus returns to the node.

Title: Filters: domain chips, institute, role, met-at-session, search with fly-to
Acceptance criteria: Filter changes re-render in under 200 ms for 300 nodes.

Title: Accessible list view, reduced-motion static layout, text alternative
Acceptance criteria: Every node reachable by keyboard in the list; no animation when reduced motion is set.

Title: Empty and low-connection states
Acceptance criteria: Zero, one and two connection states designed and shipped.

Title: Domain Venn layer: anchors, translucent hulls, multi-domain nodes pulled between anchors
Acceptance criteria: A node tagged finance and analytics sits visibly inside the overlap of both hulls.

Title: RPC venn_counts(theme_ids up to 3, scope) honouring visibility scope
Acceptance criteria: Seven region counts sum to the number of in-scope people holding at least one selected theme.

Title: Venn mode: pick up to 3 domains, 7-region counts, tap a region for people list
Acceptance criteria: Scope toggle switches My network and Event; region list opens profile panel.

Title: Similarity job: weighted score, top 8 edges per person, nightly plus on profile save
Acceptance criteria: Score reproducible from the formula in PRD section 8; job under 60 s for 2,000 profiles.

Title: Suggested connections: top 10 by score among discoverable, unconnected people
Acceptance criteria: Never lists anyone who has not opted into discoverability.

Title: Event Galaxy: all discoverable delegates as a star field with kNN links
Acceptance criteria: 2,000 nodes at 24 fps or more on a mid-range Android phone.

Title: Admin card console: batches, search delegate, bind, unbind, revoke, CSV export
Acceptance criteria: Desk volunteer binds a card to a delegate in under 30 s.

Title: Rate limits, abuse guard and feature kill-switch on resolve and connect RPCs
Acceptance criteria: Kill-switch flag disables tap and graph without a deploy.

Title: RLS and secrets audit: anon-key probe on every new table, no service key in client bundle
Acceptance criteria: Probe script returns zero rows or denial for every table; bundle grep finds no service key.

Title: Event metrics: taps, unique connections, completion rate, graph opens, errors
Acceptance criteria: Admin tile updates within 60 s of a tap.

Title: Data export and post-event deletion job (scheduled for 29 Dec 2026)
Acceptance criteria: Dry run on staging deletes all graph, consent and note rows for a test user.

Title: Device matrix: iPhone XS or later, iPhone 11 to 15, Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi, NFC off, Safari vs PWA
Acceptance criteria: Matrix sheet complete (dev tags plus 5 pre-production cards); every P0 flow passes on at least 8 devices.

Title: Load test: 500 taps per minute on resolve and connect; 2,000-node graph render
Acceptance criteria: p95 under 800 ms at 500 taps per minute; no 5xx.

Title: Delegate and volunteer onboarding: 30-second how-to-tap clip, Home banner, WhatsApp text
Acceptance criteria: Clip under 30 s; banner live on Home.

Title: Feature freeze and release candidate on production
Acceptance criteria: RC tagged; only P0 fixes merge after this point.

Title: Hypercare rota for 27 to 29 Nov, incident runbook, rollback drill
Acceptance criteria: Rota covers 07:00 to 23:00 each day; rollback drill executed once on staging.

Title: On-campus UAT with 20 volunteers using dev tags and sample cards; go or no-go
Acceptance criteria: Go/no-go recorded in decision log with named approver.

Title: Retrospective, deletion verification, metrics report
Acceptance criteria: Report shared; deletion job confirmed for 29 Dec.

Title: Scan sheet: in-app QR scan and 6-char code entry for phones without background NFC
Acceptance criteria: Camera scan and typed code resolve to the same profile screen as an NFC tap.

Title: Block and report: RPCs, profile menu, admin review queue
Acceptance criteria: Blocked user disappears from graph, Venn and directory for both sides; report lands in the admin queue.

Title: Ask and offer badges on profile and node tooltip
Acceptance criteria: Ask and offer text appears on profile and on node hover.

Title: After the conference: export contacts and follow-up reminder
Acceptance criteria: Export includes only accepted connections; reminder scheduled for the day after the event.
